Cariparo Foundation's support to international PhD students
Support of the Fondazione Cassa di Risparmio di Padova e Rovigo to international students of the 40th Cycle PhD .
Thanks to the contribution of the Fondazione Cassa di Risparmio di Padova e Rovigo, 20 contributions are available , reserved for candidates with a qualification obtained abroad and not resident in Italy, for free access to accommodation and canteen services at the structures of the ESU - Regional Agency for the Right to University Education; for the provision of these services, the University may enter into special agreements with third parties.
The proposed initiative can be traced back to the Foundation's strategy – confirmed in the 2022-2024 three-year planning document – in favor of the attractiveness and internationalization of local research centers and aims to consolidate the traditional commitment to the benefit of University of Padua PhD students with a degree obtained abroad.
